dimensions.detail: no identifier-like text columns among features

quality.note: Scores describe the data as published. Nothing here is repaired at the ingestion layer; remediation happens inside the modelling pipeline where it can be fitted per-fold.

dropped_columns.fnlwgt: Census sampling weight -- a survey-design artefact describing how many people the row represents, not a property of the person. Correlates with geographic strata, so a tree finds spurious structure in it.
dropped_columns.education: Perfectly redundant with education_num, which is the same variable as an ordinal code. Keeping both splits one signal across two columns and corrupts every importance measure.
dropped_columns.split_origin: Bookkeeping column recording which archive file the row came from.
dropped_columns.sex: Reserved for the fairness audit; excluded from features.
dropped_columns.race: Reserved for the fairness audit; excluded from features.

sensitive_policy: sex, race and age band are excluded from the feature matrix and used only to measure disparity. Exclusion does not make the model fair -- occupation, relationship and hours are all correlated proxies -- which is precisely why the audit exists.

capital_gain_structure.note: Capital gains are non-zero for a small minority but are enormously predictive within it. A single sparse feature carrying this much signal is exactly the kind of structure a tree exploits and a linear model cannot.
